title: Follow-up Reminders
meta: Automatic follow up reminders so no lead goes quiet because a reply was forgotten. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Follow up reminders so no lead is forgotten
overview: Leads rarely go cold on purpose, they just get forgotten. We set rules in your CRM so every open deal has a next step and a date. If a lead has not been contacted for a set number of days, the owner gets a task and a nudge, and a manager sees a short list of overdue deals. We choose the timing with you, test the rules on sample deals and write a short note on how to read the reminders.

faq: How often will reminders be sent?
You choose. A common start is a nudge after two or three quiet days, then a stronger one later. We set a sensible default, and you can change the timing yourself in the CRM any time.
We avoid that by limiting each person to one daily summary where possible and by skipping closed deals. Snooze options let people pause a reminder when a customer has asked for time.
No. Reminders go to your team, not to your customers. If you also want automatic customer messages, that is a separate Sales Automations job with an approval step.
Does it work on a free CRM plan?
Basic task reminders work on most free plans. Stage timing, digests and escalation may need a paid plan. We check your plan first and set up what it supports.
